notes.title: Patch 1.5
notes.content:
Hello! The Greedy Goblin Team has received so much good feedback since release, and we heard you!

Camera clipping issues have been fixed! Looting and scooting through small spaces and tight areas has never felt so good!

We thank everyone who has played our game so far, and would like to thank everyone who will play our game in the future!

Stay greedy!

tags.bug: Camera clipping issues have been fixed!
